title: WHAT IF YOU GOT A 5-STAR WANTED LEVEL IN REAL LIFE?

segments.line: It starts on a Tuesday. You wake up, and something is floating above your head.
Five empty stars, in a little row, like a crown.
Mum doesn't see them. Your little sister Ellie doesn't see them.
At school, your best friend Mo walks straight past them. At
breakfast, you wave your hand through them. Nothing. You
check the bathroom mirror. Still there, very faint, like stickers on the glass.
By lunch, you've worked out the rules.
Break any rule, even a tiny one, and a star fills in. You
test it on the way home. You step on a crack in the sidewalk.
Nothing. That's not a rule. Good to know.
If a police officer sees you while you have a star, they come for you, exactly like in a game.
And if you run, you get another star.
